stages.description: Provision replacement Fedora host, mounts, matching identities, k3s, Docker and GPU support using existing approved procedures; no reinstallation on the running host
Verify off-host manifests, restore private configuration, projects, application/PV state and registry before starting workloads; no live overwrite or job replay
Restore paths and secrets through existing owners; inspect registry/groups before any broad reconcile
Reconcile source-owned platform/services after data restoration; preserve desired zero replicas and do not change networking
Restore images/model files and controller state; independently qualify new cluster UIDs, admission and cutover proofs. Old proof booleans are not reusable evidence
Restore app, memory and Toolkit via independently pinned images; install plugins/agents/skills; verify native health before resuming sessions
Reconcile only selected integrations against the inventory; do not rerun historical learning migrations or enable services merely because source exists
Verify exact workload/image/mount/secret/unit coverage, native API and controller, independent memory restore, project source, a harmless bounded worker job and a new off-host backup/restore test
